title: The Entire Bar Falls Silent 😨⚽
script: The ball gets passed. Then again. Then suddenly everyone's on their feet. Nobody breathes. The keeper stretches. The striker shoots. The net ripples. And then — absolute mayhem. Beers spill. Strangers grab each other. Someone screams so loud the windows shake. The bar has become a church and we are all preaching the same sermon: WE SCORED.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long dark hair, dark casual hoodie, standing in a packed lively sports bar watching a World Cup match on a big screen [Static shot, low angle, bar lights dim with screen glow]. Tension builds — everyone on their feet — she grips the edge of the bar, mouth open, eyes wide [Tracking shot moving across row of tense fans]. Goal is scored — she whips around, throws both arms up, screams with abandon [Push in on her face, pure shock turning to euphoria]. Second clip: drinks are flying, high fives everywhere, she's hugging the stranger next to her mid-air [Tracking shot following chaotic celebration]. Neon bar signs glow, screens flash the score, confetti poppers burst [Pull out to wide shot of entire bar celebrating]. Modern sports bar, night game atmosphere, cinematic lighting, 9:16 portrait.
